message.hamster.tame_first: Tame the hamster with seeds first
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.hamster: Adds hamsters: tamed and bred with seeds, they follow their owner, sit on command, can be picked up into the inventory while sneaking and thrown - a thrown hamster kills a creeper and stays alive. Five colour variants. They live in plains, sunflower plains and meadows. The hamster wheel gives a comparator signal. Zombies and skeletons are afraid of hamsters.
